{"items":[{"ref":"R09","coverage_id":"3c57d1bfeec301a5061a3aac","coverage_title":"初始选择时段页","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"画面明确为第1步，不满足非首步适用条件。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-ed5981943d36420abcbcfb932f3a6a84"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["选择时段页：上午项选中"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R09","coverage_id":"cb2c03e46e454322f59c5ca9","coverage_title":"下午项选中的选择时段页","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"切换下午项及返回后的画面均明确为第1步；返回到首步不使该页成为非首步。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-7a09dc68a4fd47958ab10ea4889fb401","ev-4a119973f66c4bb5823812d82b6658dd"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["选择时段页：下午项选中"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R09","coverage_id":"d26ef33e7cf79b4071dfdc34","coverage_title":"核对信息页的返回入口","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"当前为第2步，任务卡明确仅为可复位的本机登记；检查页面返回入口，浏览器导航不在截图范围内。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-8d4c111e8c2b4c5e92e09db4172c0e24","ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["核对信息页","返回选择按钮"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0","obj-2ba5c91c54257c9ca213"],"constraint_refs":["REQ2"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R09","coverage_id":"coverage-23c64aec5c8661f5","coverage_title":"BR2提交后的完成页导航","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"提交动作仅获授权，尚无完成页；需确认终态性质及导航区域后确定适用性。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-8d4c111e8c2b4c5e92e09db4172c0e24","ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a"],"evidence_needed":["提交后的完整完成页及可见导航"],"object_refs":["BR2待观察的完成页"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ3","REQ4"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R10","coverage_id":"d26ef33e7cf79b4071dfdc34","coverage_title":"核对信息页的风险确认适用性","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"任务卡明确登记仅在当前页面生效且可复位，属于非高风险演示确认，不符合本条高风险前提。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-8d4c111e8c2b4c5e92e09db4172c0e24"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["核对信息页","提交登记按钮"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0","obj-96d6f72e97ca58664da8"],"constraint_refs":["REQ4"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R11","coverage_id":"cb2c03e46e454322f59c5ca9","coverage_title":"选择页核对信息动作的入口数量","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"选择页仅一个“核对信息”入口；返回后再次出现的是同一入口，未构成两个同动作入口。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-7a09dc68a4fd47958ab10ea4889fb401","ev-4a119973f66c4bb5823812d82b6658dd"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["核对信息按钮"],"object_ids":["obj-d18c45035f1cf481864b"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R11","coverage_id":"d26ef33e7cf79b4071dfdc34","coverage_title":"核对页返回与提交动作的命名范围","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"返回选择与提交登记是不同动作，各仅一个入口；重复截图不增加入口数量，不满足同动作多入口条件。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-54c27ab204c6479384eced085b8c3114","ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab","ev-8d4c111e8c2b4c5e92e09db4172c0e24"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["返回选择按钮","提交登记按钮"],"object_ids":["obj-2ba5c91c54257c9ca213","obj-96d6f72e97ca58664da8"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]}]}
